judgment.summary: Confirmed container escape attack on production Kubernetes node. Privileged pod with Docker socket mount enabled direct host control, corroborated by related alerts showing compromised CI token usage and active host process execution.

iocs.context: Source IP of compromised Kubernetes worker node executing malicious privileged pod

remediation: Immediately isolate network traffic for node 10.0.6.50 to prevent lateral movement.
Force delete pod evil-pod in default namespace to terminate the container escape vector.
Revoke CI token associated with user jane.doe to stop further unauthorized pod creation.
Conduct forensic analysis on host 10.0.6.50 to identify persistence mechanisms established via docker socket.
Audit and rotate all service account tokens within the affected Kubernetes cluster.
